correctness.rationale: The universal cycle calculation follows from the published connected-partition Möbius recursion and Narayana path formal series by marking cyclic interval partitions n/k times, summing the k-series exactly, and changing variables to the unique positive unary–binary tree series. Lagrange inversion gives every multinomial coefficient. Termwise positivity and n−1 constant gamma entry are proved, not inferred from finite checks. Standalone independent bond-lattice enumeration matches all coefficients through cycle order nine; coefficients and positivity additionally checked through order eighty.

value.rationale: This is a natural nonchordal family singled out by the new weighted-bond invariant and broad gamma-positivity conjecture. Unlike the already known qualitative positivity, the result gives the entire exact bivariate gamma enumerator, a cancellation-free Motzkin-forest combinatorial interpretation, direct multinomial coefficient formulas for every order, and strict coefficient positivity. These are nontrivial parameter-wide numerical refinements with standalone independent checks.
